The result marks the sixth lead change in as many months and comes as the Prime Minister's net favourability rating has fallen sharply.

Actual Article Body:
By CAITLIN POWELL - NEWS REPORTER

Published:  09:36 AEST, 6 October 2026   |  Updated:  09:36 AEST, 6 October 2026

Pauline Hanson's One Nation has pulled ahead of Labor in fresh polling data while Anthony Albanese's approval ratings have dropped to a significant low.

One Nation moved ahead of Labor on 29 per cent of the primary vote compared with Labor's 28 per cent, according to a RedBridge Group and Accent Research poll for the Australian Financial Review.

The data, published on Sunday, marks the sixth lead change in as many months and comes as the Prime Minister's net favourability rating has fallen sharply.

The metric, which is Albanese's favourability rating minus unfavourability, decreased by 10 points over one month to -27 per cent.
